method.objective: maximise mean f1_tolerant over the training events
method.tie_break: grid order, i.e. declaration order in strandline/config.py TUNE_GRID
method.split: leave-one-event-out over the flood events in the pool

caveats: The two modes have different numbers of grid candidates (darkening: 18, rough_water: 12), so the mode with more candidates has more chances to fit the training events. Only the held-out numbers decide which mode is adopted.

The primary metric is flood-affected area (our flood classes UNION debris) against each reference's flooded + debris/mass-movement classes, decided in docs/tuning_log.md before this mode was scored. Water-only scores are in each event's score file.
Measured with n_pre=3 pre-event images, not the shipped default 5: a thinner reference stack gives noisier per-pixel std.
Control false-flood rates are in-sample: every control was used as a feasibility constraint when choosing parameters, so they are not an out-of-sample estimate.
Flood events whose reference came from Sentinel-1 are written as kind=flood_dependent and cannot move a gate; they can still appear in the pool.
Nothing here is applied to strandline/config.py. A human makes that edit.
